newsitem.title: JAPAN: Eikoh to list shares on Tokyo bourse.
newsitem.headline: Eikoh to list shares on Tokyo bourse.

text.p: Shares of Eikoh Inc will be listed on the second section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) on December 20, the exchange said in a statement on Monday.
Eikoh, a Japanese cram school operator, is currently an over-the-counter issue.
It will issue one million new shares at the time of the listing and will also sell another one million shares through a secondary offering, the TSE said.
